header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.6.1: elytra dive / bow / crossbow lifecycle is now also written to the persistent debug log (visible with /pvpbot:debugdump even when debug flags are off), so dive attempts, mace strikes and ranged shots can be verified from logs. v0.6.0: bow/crossbow arrows spawn ahead of the muzzle (no self-hits); elytra guarantees at least one mace strike per launch, up to 3 strikes, watchdog force-ends stalled dives; crystal detonation above the head banned (except surround), feet-level prioritized. v0.5.6: undefined-entry hardening for SimulatedPlayer. v0.5.5: ender_crystal entity id fix. v0.5.4: hard 0-value cooldowns preserved; hole escape; block spam tamed. v0.5.3: namespaced /bot alias. v0.5.2: sourceEntity caller resolution.
